title: The Waist row target "Target <89" has no unit while the page shows "<89 cm", and the grid's Weight trend shows an amber dash with no data
evidence: Seen in the PR 1508 shots: the My health Waist row reads "Target <89" with no unit, while its value page reads "<89 cm". The vitals grid's Weight trend cell shows an amber dash when there is no data; amber reads as a warning. (H83)
